mapper.sql: i.id, i.biz_no, i.template_id, i.template_version, i.form_data_id, i.form_type, i.category, i.initiator_id, i.initiator_org_id, i.initiator_company_id, i.initiator_org_path, i.approver_snapshot_json, i.status, i.sub_status, i.current_node_seq, i.current_dept_id, i.owner_dept_id, i.routing_seq, i.routing_count, i.supplement_count, i.submitted_at, i.finished_at, i.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM flow_instance i WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND i.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM flow_instance i WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND i.biz_no = #{bizNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM flow_instance i WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND i.biz_no = #{bizNo}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM flow_instance i WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=flow_instance, alias=i) */ AND i.template_id = #{templateId} AND i.status = 'approving'
AND i.template_version = #{templateVersion}
SELECT f.creator_id FROM form_data f WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=form_data, alias=f) */ AND f.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT f.fields_json FROM form_data f WHERE 1 = 1 AND /* @dataScope(table=form_data, alias=f) */ AND f.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_instance (biz_no, template_id, template_version, form_data_id, form_type, category, initiator_id, initiator_org_id, initiator_company_id, initiator_org_path, approver_snapshot_json, status, current_node_seq, owner_dept_id, routing_seq, routing_count, supplement_count) VALUES (#{bizNo}, #{templateId}, #{templateVersion}, #{formDataId}, #{formType}, #{category}, #{initiatorId}, #{initiatorOrgId}, #{initiatorCompanyId}, #{initiatorOrgPath}, #{approverSnapshotJson}, IFNULL(#{status}, 'draft'), #{currentNodeSeq}, #{ownerDeptId}, 0, 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_instance SET approver_snapshot_json = #{approverSnapshotJson}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE flow_instance SET status = 'approving', current_node_seq = #{currentNodeSeq}, submitted_at = IFNULL(submitted_at, NOW()), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'draft'
UPDATE flow_instance SET status = #{status}, sub_status = #{subStatus}, current_node_seq = #{currentNodeSeq}, current_dept_id = #{currentDeptId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE flow_instance SET status = #{status}, sub_status = NULL, finished_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE flow_instance SET routing_count = routing_count + 1, routing_seq = routing_seq + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE flow_instance SET supplement_count = supplement_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE flow_instance SET status = 'draft', sub_status = NULL, current_node_seq = NULL, current_dept_id = NULL, finished_at = NULL, template_id = #{templateId}, template_version = #{templateVersion}, approver_snapshot_json = #{approverSnapshotJson}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO form_data (biz_no, form_type, fields_json, schema_version, creator_id) VALUES (#{bizNo}, #{formType}, IFNULL(#{fieldsJson}, '{}'), IFNULL(#{schemaVersion}, 1), #{creatorId})
